solver_notes: Add a scheduler-level hard injection-queue fallback at tick 64 in Core::next_task, independent of the tuned global_queue_interval. Existing coop::budget wraps the task and nested LIFO polls, while poll_proceed decrements committed progress and forces a yield at zero. The regression harness reproduces starvation for 130 ticks with continuous local work and a large tuned interval, proves the patched worker selects injected work at tick 64, checks 128 committed budget decrements followed by forced yield, and checks baseline local/global/empty behavior. This bounds starvation across returning polls; no cooperative scheduler can preempt one Future::poll invocation that never returns. Internal file_sha256_of_this_json is SHA-256 of the compact UTF-8 JSON object with this field null; bus payload_sha256 is SHA-256 of actual transmitted bytes.

assertions: legacy scheduler starves global task through 130 ticks
fixed fallback returns global task at tick 64
